name: uint32 clock wrap
criterion: Unsigned elapsed age remains correct across millis wrap.

name: Timer1 wrap
criterion: Rising near 65535 then falling after wrap yields short correct pulse, never huge distance.

name: missing echo
criterion: 30ms echo timeout invalidates range and asserts fault; trigger never blocks CPU.

name: noise edge
criterion: Unmatched or repeated edges cannot create a false clear sample.

name: independent sources
criterion: Clearing one registered source leaves another active contributor asserted.

name: ISR while MAIN stalled
criterion: ISR gates motor/lamp/wiper/horn registers immediately; UART session retained and sync flag set.

name: IRQ during reversal
criterion: Pending reversal canceled; foreground stale state cannot restore output.

name: old ACT after clear
criterion: Old epoch remains inhibited after line release until strictly newer STOP epoch accepted.

name: strict new epoch STOP
criterion: New STOP after line high synchronizes; same epoch does not; fresh model command needed.

name: false clear bus
criterion: Physical low line blocks actuation despite valid clear telemetry.

name: stale bus high line
criterion: High line with stale/CRC-invalid telemetry blocks actuation.

name: late ACK old epoch
criterion: Old epoch ACK cannot mark appliedKnown or restore requested state.

name: explicit SLM STOP
criterion: Requested drive 0 published immediately; applied unknown until matching ACK; SLM+ADAS receive coherent revision.

name: drive lease
criterion: 500ms motor lease expiry becomes actual 0 and desired 0 after observed status, retaining ancillary outputs.

name: metadata negatives
criterion: H32/old protocol/old labels rejected; full H64 metadata requires include-bias=1.

name: full CPP logits
criterion: All ten real full-worker scores match frozen full kernel and include global bias exactly once.

name: immutable identity
criterion: Repeated request ID requires identical operation and payload; changed payload rejected without action.
